title: One mailbox object assigns UIDs and never loses a delivery
statement: Mail SHALL keep each mailbox in one Durable Object that pulls deliveries into SQLite, assigning UIDs that only rise, never losing a delivery that commits late, never letting one bad message stop later ones, and keeping an expunged message's bytes readable until they are erased (FR-MAIL-053) and its row after that. It SHALL tell every registered IMAP session of any change without ever waiting for the telling.
